name: GENDERWRECKED
source:
GENDERWRECKED is a post-apocalyptic genderpunk visual novel about traveling broken lands and kissing/fighting/talking to monsters in an attempt to learn the true meaning of a mysterious force called GENDER.

[From [url=https://gendervamp.itch.io/genderwrecked]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《性别失控》是一部末日后的性别朋克视觉小说，讲述玩家穿越破碎大地，通过与怪物接吻、战斗、交谈，试图理解一种名为“性别”的神秘力量真正含义的故事。

[来源：[url=https://gendervamp.itch.io/genderwrecked]Itch.io[/url]]
